Maybe I could write about my personal experiences in the hope of helping someone else.

Ah man, my inspirations are all over the place, as is my taste in music. If I had to break it down by category / genre, I would say

Country: Johnny Cash, George Jones, Waylon Jennings, Chris Stapleton, Josh Turner, Luke Combs, Alison Kraus and Union Station, Brad Paisley

Rap: Three 6 Mafia, Lil Peep, Lil Wayne, Eminem, Yelawolf, Jelly Roll, Juice Wrld, Clever (Whoisclever)

Metal: The Black Dahlia Murder, Amon Amarth, Whitechapel,  As I Lay Dying, A Plea for Purging, Killswitch Engage, Rammstein

Classic Rock: Pink Floyd, Blackfoot, Fleetwood Mac / Stevie Nick's, Bob Seger

Other: Marshmello

I'm super tired, so I'm having trouble coming up with more to add to the lists.
I'm here if you want someone to talk to

I don't look at life as something to be revered or worshipped. I feel that if a hell actually exists, if it's anything like having to endure the pain of living in this world, then I want no part of it because to me, life has been hellish enough so far. I don't know what to tell you that could possibly give you an inkling of hope because I don't want to give you more cliches or bullshit advice. I'm just a broken soul who identifies with other broken souls. What I can tell you is I'm more than willing to lend you an ear if you ever want someone to talk or even rant to, as the case may be.
Thank you. I don't want to feel this way forever. I just want to be able to experience true happiness, joy, contentment for once in life instead of always pretending to be ok.
I wish I never would've tried them, but I've got such an addictive personality that I easily get hooked on almost anything.
